rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0001, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=42, rationale=iter-9, ONE-KNOB change vs the iter-8 NEW PEAK base (SSIM 0.9747, PSNR 38.63 dB; img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, n_iter=300). KNOB: projection-domain BF range sigma proj_sr 0.0005 -> 0.0001 (push the SAME winning tight/edge-preserving direction even tighter in the sinogram). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-8 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=16, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, seed=42; proj_sx/proj_sy left at Wagner-abdomen defaults). TRAJECTORY: iter-1 0.9720/38.17; iter-2 (ALL THREE proj sigmas at once off loose iter-1 base) 0.9680/37.90 HURT; iter-3 (img_sr 0.02->0.0005) 0.9723/38.19; iter-4 (img_n_bf 1->3) 0.9732/38.21 PEAK; iter-5 (img_n_bf 3->5) 0.9729 SAT; iter-6 (img_kernel 7->9) 0.9731 FLAT; iter-7 (n_iter 300->600) 0.9732 FLAT; iter-8 (proj_sr 0.02->0.0005, ISOLATED) 0.9747/38.63 NEW PEAK +0.0015 -- the projection-domain range sigma is the ACTIVE winning lever, breaking the prior ~0.973 ceiling. FAILURE MODE addressed: at the loose proj_sr the projection BF under-denoised / Gaussian-blurred the sinogram edge before FBP; tightening to 0.0005 made it edge-preserving on the air/breast attenuation boundary and lifted SSIM/PSNR. WHY proj_sr->0.0001 NOW: proj_sr is the only lever still actively improving (img depth/kernel/sigma/n_iter all exhausted; iter-8 just broke the ceiling by tightening it). img_sr already showed the breast substrate wants TIGHT range sigmas (mayo_campaign_state.md: 'breast wants img_sr->0.0005'); the symmetric proj_sr lever just proved the same direction in the sinogram. The natural one-knob continuation of a proven monotone win is to extend it: 5x tighter (0.0005->0.0001), <<< the breast sinogram value range, maximally edge-preserving on the attenuation boundary. proj_n_bf 1->2 (a 2nd projection BF) is the alternative adjacent knob but is a structural/capacity step (doubles the proj stack, more confounded); the trend says the tight-range DIRECTION produces the gain, so push it before changing structure. HYPOTHESIS: does the projection-domain range-tightening gain CONTINUE or SATURATE? If proj_sr=0.0001 lifts SSIM above iter-8's 0.9747, the projection BF still has edge-preserving headroom and proj_sr->even-tighter (or proj_n_bf 1->2) is the next iter; if FLAT (within +-0.0005 of 0.9747) or DROPS, proj_sr=0.0005 is the projection-range optimum and the next probe moves to the adjacent projection knob (proj_n_bf 1->2 to add a 2nd projection BF now that the tight-range regime is established). WALL: step budget IDENTICAL to iter-8 (n_iter=300, val_n=16; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 16x300=4800); iter-8 ran 457 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged.
